author: KirkHerbstreit
text:
Here’s Fowler, my spotters, and me reacting to an INCREDIBLE finish to regulation between Minnesota and Indiana while our game was still finishing up!

Two 60-yard field goals back-to-back!! Congrats to Indiana!! INSANE
